description: The ladder of rates a currency has on its latest day: the central bank's official rate, the interbank rate, what banks quote (buy / sell), the customs rate duties are computed at, what international cards settle at and the street rate — each with its publication day, the number of sources and a confidence class — the gap of the street over every rung, the width of the ladder, its 7- and 30-day trend and a widening signal (none / watch / alert), with a ready citation. A rung the country does not publish on its own says which rung it equals. Free level: the official, customs and street rungs of the free currencies, one day behind. Paid keys of the FX Rate Stack: every rung, every active currency, today.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, for example EGP, NGN, ARS

lang.description: Language of the citation text (ISO 639-1 code of a site language: en, ru, es, ar, tr, uz); default English
